sourceText: Create and drive a new Lattice story for the evidence-integrity program section-5 follow-on (docs/evidence-integrity-program-spec.md section 5): frozen-field / doc-promise drift (userSees F-027/F-060, plan.md F-059). Goal: detect when a story's frozen fields drift from what was actually delivered and require a re-attestation (reusing B-ec67's M1 receipt / re-attestation mechanism) rather than silently accepting the stale promise. It is NOT B-1507 (verification_run + refresh re-execution + PreToolUse) and NOT B-3b88 (prose-only refresh laundering) -- its own story. The operator then refined the ask into two milestones: Phase 1 = detection + reporting (claim snapshot; receipt saves claim digest; detect drift; structured diff; fail-closed or manual for now); Phase 2 = reviewer re-attestation, forced re-execution when substantive, old receipt marked stale, new receipt bound to new claim, gate restored, full audit trail. Acceptance criteria requested: drift detection (userSees / DoneWhen / Verify semantic change detected; unrelated doc changes do not invalidate evidence; whitespace normalization by explicit rule; add/remove/modify claim each recognized); evidence state (old receipt kept but marked stale; stale cannot satisfy a gate; no silent digest update; new execution -> new receipt referencing current claim digest); re-attestation (authorized reviewer confirms non-semantic; substantive change forces re-execution; implementing agent cannot self-attest; record actor/reason/time/old+new digest; failure blocks the story); compat/migration (historical receipts without claim digest handled explicitly; not assumed valid forever; not all history broken at once; mark legacy-unbound and require confirmation on reopen/advance; active stories migrate at next gate; new stories use the new format). Tightened definition: bind verification receipts to canonical claim snapshots, detect semantic drift in frozen checklist and plan claims, and require authorized re-attestation or re-execution before those receipts can satisfy lifecycle gates again. Priority: below malformed red-evidence bugs that crash a live gate, above ordinary config/docs/perf cleanup. The operator also directed that engineering scope calls be made and recorded via the Lattice decision mechanism (decision_set + scope-plan reviewer + cross-host quorum) rather than deferred back as approval popups.
normalizedOutcome: Phase 1 observable outcome: a developer or gate-reader runs a read-only command and sees, for any story, each checklist userSees whose normalized claim text OR story-owned material (storyFilesHash) has drifted since it was attested at status=done, reported as a structured NON-blocking FROZEN_CLAIM_DRIFT advisory with actionRequired=re_attestation; userSees with no snapshot are reported as legacy-unbound; nothing is blocked; and a deterministic offline smoke including two false-positive guards is green under validate. Phase 2 (blocking gate + reviewer re-attestation recovery + legacy migration policy) and general plan.md DoneWhen/Verify drift are separate and deferred.
acceptanceClaim: Running `node bin/lattice.js frozen_claim_drift_check --storyId=<id>` on a story whose userSees drifted (material or claim) prints a structured FROZEN_CLAIM_DRIFT advisory with driftKind and actionRequired=re_attestation, classifies a no-snapshot userSees as legacy-unbound, changes no gate verdict, and the frozen-claim-drift smoke (including the unrelated-change and whitespace-only false-positive guards) is green under `node bin/lattice.js validate`.
